title: 第3章 艳惊座绝舞

content_zh:
终于到了三天后，离烟登台表演的日子。还未到时辰，三层楼的点花坊已经是人满为患。专门卫表演筑起的台子用醉红的纱幔装饰得妖艳旖旎，离烟身穿着雪白色的舞衣自纱幔后现身，脸上罩一方同色同质的巾帕，在一片鲜红之中分外的夺目。
花飘儿倚在二楼栏杆上，用满意又带着几分慵懒的目光望着楼下众多客人为台上的离烟欢呼、迷醉，这个丫头，不管她从哪里来、是什么人、投奔在她点花坊是什么目的，她是会为她带来财运的，而绝非麻烦，有这一点就足够了！她想着，目光辗转到门口突然定住了，他怎么会来？只是愣了那么一愣，她抬手扶了扶脑后的发髻，风姿绰约地朝来人走去，笑得嫣然，“哟，箫大公子你怎么来了？”
她口中的“箫大公子”正是凌殇阁副阁主箫逸，在未入阁前他们便是旧识，因此花飘儿并不向他行上司与下属之间的虚礼。箫逸收回目光望向她，嘴边一丝若有若无的笑意，“来看你啊。”
“你这么说，我可是会误会的。”花飘儿娇笑着引他上楼，吩咐人备下酒菜，与他凭栏对坐，“莫非萧阁主也是为了这‘绝舞’而来？”
箫逸闻言望了一眼楼下，复又望向她，“如果我说是，你会怎样？”
“我还能怎样？”花飘儿依然笑得迷人，一手托腮望向楼下，“你的心从来就不在我这里，我能怎样？如果能怎样，你还不早就是我的了？离烟虽美，也美不过你心里的那个人，你说，我还能怎样呢？”
她幽幽地道来，似哀怨又似娇嗔，软绵绵的嗓音听得人耳膜酥软，但对面的人却丝毫不为所动，反而皱了皱眉头，“飘儿！”
“好好好，我不说了。”花飘儿放下支脸的手为他斟了杯茶，“我不提她就是了，你不要生气。怎么，今天当真是为了离烟来的？”
箫逸端起茶杯浅呷了一口，放下，“点花坊打出的‘绝舞’这张牌可是轰动了全京城，今夜至少有半个城的人都聚在这里，飘儿你越来越会做生意了！”
“你怕人多会出事？”花飘儿扬了扬眉，从他的话中听到了另外的含义，他果然想得很周到！“你这话，明里是赞我，暗里却是在怪我。是我没有考虑周全，之前应该先知会你一声的。”箫逸主要负责阁里和京城的安全，如果今夜有人趁机捣乱或是出了什么别的事，他一定责无旁贷！“我坏了阁里的规矩，明天会自动去受戒堂报到。”
箫逸凝视了她半晌，叹息，“你就不能少聪明一次？”
“少聪明一次？”花飘儿凤眼一瞪，啐他，“你能少聪明一次吗？如果我连这个都听不出来，那我们两个早就连小命都没了！箫逸啊箫逸，你真的是这么想的吗？”
箫逸沉默了片刻，将目光移向楼下，“我只是不希望你太辛苦。我一早就劝你放下点花坊，如果可以，找个好人嫁了，可你偏偏不听。这么多年，你为我做的够多了，真的无需再这样费尽心思……”他似乎不善于说这样煽情的话，因此说了一半便停住了，顿了一顿，他才接着道：“我已经派了阁里的守卫守在城里各大要道，点花坊周围更是有重兵把守，应该不会出什么问题的。受戒堂那里你不要去，他们追究起来，我自会处理。”
“唉——”他话音刚落，花飘儿就重重地叹了口气，“你知不知道有的时候你真的很残忍？你明明死都不肯爱我，却又偏偏对我这么好；明明让我看到有希望，可当我接近的时候却发现是一条死巷子。我又偏偏舍不下，你说，叫我如何是好？”
箫逸又是一阵沉默，半晌才道：“我对不起你。”
“现在还说这个做什么？我呀，也就是嘴上说说，什么时候真的怨过你？”花飘儿边说边提起茶壶为他续了茶，“不过有一件事，我觉得还是告诉你的好。”说着，她把对离烟的怀疑原原本本地讲给他听。
箫逸听完沉吟了一下，“静观其变。你自己小心点，我过两天可能要出趟远门。”
“出远门？”花飘儿愣了一下，随即释然，“是要去岭南吧？我还以为阁主不会插手呢，没想到会让你亲自去！岭南雪家这次巨变，当真是地动山摇啊——”

content_en:
Finally, three days later, the day came for Li Yan to perform on stage. Before the time came, the three-story flower shop was already overcrowded. The stage built specifically for dance performances was beautifully decorated with rich red gauze curtains. Li Yan appeared from behind the gauze curtains wearing a snow-white dance costume. His face was covered with a scarf of the same color and texture, which was particularly eye-catching in the bright red.
Hua Piao'er leaned on the railing on the second floor, looking at the many guests downstairs with satisfaction and a bit of laziness as they cheered and enchanted Li Yan on the stage. This girl, no matter where she came from, who she was, or why she came to her flower shop, she would bring her wealth, not trouble. This was enough! She thought, her eyes turned to the door and suddenly froze, how could he come? After being stunned for a moment, she raised her hand to hold the bun on the back of her head, and walked towards the visitor gracefully, smiling brightly, "Hey, Mr. Xiao, why are you here?"
The "eldest son Xiao" she refers to is Xiao Yi, the deputy master of Lingshang Pavilion. They were old acquaintances before joining the pavilion, so Hua Piao'er did not pay him the false courtesy between a superior and a subordinate. Xiao Yi looked back at her, with a faint smile on her lips, "I came to see you."
"If you say that, I might have misunderstood." Hua Piao'er smiled coquettishly and led him upstairs, ordered people to prepare food and drinks, and sat across from him on the railing. "Could it be that Pavilion Master Xiao is also here for this 'Absolute Dance'?"
Hearing this, Xiao Yi glanced downstairs, then looked at her again, "What would you do if I said yes?"
"What else can I do?" Hua Piao'er still smiled charmingly and looked downstairs with one hand on her chin, "Your heart has never been with me, what can I do? If it could, you would have been mine long ago? Although Li Yan is beautiful, she is not as beautiful as the person in your heart. What else can I do?"
She spoke quietly, sounding sad and angry at the same time. Her soft voice made people's eardrums soften, but the person opposite was not moved at all. Instead, she frowned, "Piao'er!"
"Okay, okay, I won't say anything anymore." Hua Piao'er put down the hand that was holding her face and poured him a cup of tea, "I'll just leave her alone. Don't be angry. What, are you really here for Li Yan today?"
Xiao Yi picked up the teacup, took a sip, and then put it down, "The 'Jue Wu' card played by Dianhuafang has caused a sensation in the whole capital. At least half of the city has gathered here tonight. Piao'er, you are getting better and better at doing business!"
"Are you afraid that something will happen if there are too many people?" Hua Piao'er raised her eyebrows and heard another meaning from his words. He was really thoughtful! "What you said is to praise me openly, but secretly you are blaming me. I didn't think it through carefully. I should have warned you beforehand." Xiao Yi is mainly responsible for the security of the pavilion and the capital. If someone takes the opportunity to cause trouble or something else happens tonight, he will definitely bear the responsibility! "I broke the rules in the pavilion. I will automatically report to the ordination hall tomorrow."
Xiao Yi stared at her for a long time and sighed, "Can't you be less clever for once?"
"Be less smart for once?" Hua Piao'er glared at him and spat at him, "Can you be less smart for once? If I couldn't even hear this, then both of us would have lost our lives long ago! Xiao Yi, Xiao Yi, do you really think so?"
Xiao Yi was silent for a moment, then moved her gaze downstairs, "I just don't want you to work too hard. I advised you to put down your flower shop early in the morning, and if possible, find a good man to marry, but you just didn't listen. You have done enough for me over the years, and you really don't need to put in so much effort..." He seemed not good at saying this. Such sensational words, so he stopped mid-sentence, paused, and then continued: "I have sent guards from the pavilion to guard the major thoroughfares in the city, and there are heavy guards around Dianhuafang. There shouldn't be any problems. Don't go to the ordination hall. If they investigate, I will handle it."
"Alas -" as soon as he finished speaking, Hua Piao'er sighed heavily, "Do you knowAre you really cruel sometimes? You obviously refused to love me to death, but you still treated me so well. You obviously showed me hope, but when I got closer, I found it was a dead end. I just can’t let it go. What do you want me to do? "
Xiao Yi was silent again for a while, then said: "I'm sorry for you. "
"Why are you talking about this now? I, just talking about it, when have I ever really complained about you? Hua Piao'er said as she picked up the teapot and refilled the tea for him, "But there's one thing I think it's best to tell you." "As she said that, she told him her suspicions about Li Yan.
Xiao Yi pondered for a moment after hearing this, "Just wait and see what happens. Be careful, I may have to go on a long trip in two days. "
"Travelling? Hua Piao'er was stunned for a moment, then relieved, "Are you going to Lingnan?" I thought the Pavilion Master wouldn't interfere, but I didn't expect you to go there in person! This great change in the Lingnan Xue family is really shaking the earth——"
